power.on.title: Host powered on
power.on.body: The host's power LED turned on.

power.off.title: Host powered off
power.off.body: The host's power LED turned off.

hdmi.lost.title: HDMI signal lost
hdmi.lost.body: The host stopped sending a picture.

hdmi.restored.title: HDMI signal restored
hdmi.restored.body: The host sends a picture again.

hdmi.power-cycle.title: Power cycle recommended
hdmi.power-cycle.body: The HDMI receiver got an updated EDID, for example for correct colours. Unplug the NanoKVM from all power and plug it back in to apply it.

security.lockout.title: Logins blocked
security.lockout.body: {failures} failed logins from {address}: logins from this address are blocked for {minutes} min.

security.attempt-limit.title: Login attempts limited
security.attempt-limit.body: {attempts} login attempts from {address} in a minute: further attempts from this address are refused for {minutes} min.

security.new-address.title: Login from a new address
security.new-address.body: {user} logged in from {address}, an address not seen before.

screen.panic.title: Kernel panic on the host
screen.panic.body: The host's console shows a crash.

test.title: Test notification
test.body: Notifications from this NanoKVM reach this channel.

action.media-ejected.title: Image ejected
action.media-ejected.body: {actor} took the image out of the virtual drive.

journal.dropped.title: Events not recorded
journal.dropped.body: {count} events were left out: more than the journal takes in a minute.

watchdog.agent-silent.title: Sensors agent silent
watchdog.agent-silent.body: The host's sensors agent has sent nothing for {minutes} min, but the host answers on the USB network: the agent stopped. Nothing was done.

watchdog.host-silent.title: Host does not respond
watchdog.host-silent.body: The host's sensors agent has sent nothing for {minutes} min and the host does not answer on the USB network. Nothing was pressed: the watchdog is set to notify.

watchdog.reset.title: Host reset by the watchdog
watchdog.reset.body: The host's sensors agent sent nothing for {minutes} min and the host did not answer on the USB network: the reset button was pressed.

watchdog.cycle.title: Host power-cycled by the watchdog
watchdog.cycle.body: The host's sensors agent sent nothing for {minutes} min and the host did not answer on the USB network: it was switched off and on.

watchdog.failed.title: Watchdog action failed
watchdog.failed.body: The host stopped responding ({minutes} min of silence), but the action failed: {error}
